test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, select the number that will be on the face opposite the face showing the number '5'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2f3fb4b80c724bd46a6a9968708114a9bb6536f529c1e33a7df4ff90b64881b.png]
solution:
Faces opposite to each other is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb3f446bdbf5069ec72c7b526ce45f4975bf55760ed8c59e13341426d066bd05.png] 

Clearly, '9' is the number that will be on the face opposite the face showing the number '5'.

Hence, '**9**' is the correct answer.
